messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] What's the meaning of I(·) in the model formula?
parts:
The I() construction is a general R linear model device that is typically used to encapsulate
covariates that are functions of the input data, e.g. as I(x^2)
I'm not sure what the reason for it's use in the code you quoted is, as it seems to simply used the
variables directly.

Finn
